wh3_dlc23_spell_bound_enfeebling_foe.tooltip: By means of the Lore of Shadows, the Wizard causes the enemy to be worn down by their own burdens, until they are enervated to a sorry standstill.

wh3_dlc24_item_abilities_the_golden_eye_.tooltip: This potent talisman consists of a filigree of witch-hair cradling the fossilised eye of a Lord of Change; its bearer develops a sixth-sense that warns him of threats from afar.

wh2_main_item_abilities_the_guiding_eye.tooltip: Wrought in black iron with an oval ruby at its centre, the Guiding Eye grants mystical sight to its wearer.

wh_main_weapon_abilities_the_hammer_of_k.tooltip: The Hammer of Karak Drazh was struck with such powerful runes it can be swung with preternatural ease.

wh_dlc04_item_abilities_the_liber_noctus.tooltip: This decrepit tome bristles with dark secrets and eldritch powers. Reading from it summons dark thoughts and grim deeds.

wh_dlc07_lord_abilities_lions_shield.tooltip: King Louen’s shield has protected him from the first days of his Knighthood; strengthened by enchantment, it will continue to do so.

ui_effects_text: Mutually exclusive with Dance of Destruction and Daggerdance

wh2_main_spell_bound_the_seerstaff_of_sa.tooltip: The spirits of ancient warriors are summoned and lend their might to allies in the present.

wh2_main_item_abilities_the_tricksters_p.tooltip: All those who seek the favour of Loec wear a simple-looking pendant of silver that actually conceals great power.

wh3_dlc23_item_abilities_the_vial_of_has.tooltip: Within this ampoule is contained the "Blood of Hashut"; though highly unlikely to be true, it is nevertheless a powerful alchemical substance that ignites metal on contact.

wh2_main_item_abilities_the_vortex_shard.tooltip: Hewn from the same rock that forms the Waystones, the Vortex Shard has the power to becalm the Winds of Magic.

wh_dlc08_item_abilities_the_wintertooth_.tooltip: Whether by the crown's own properties, or by the grace of the Dark Gods, all things bestial and savage obey the wearer.

wh2_dlc13_weapon_abilities_wissenland_ru.tooltip: One of twelve magical swords belonging to the Empire's Elector Counts, 'Blood Bringer' is a mighty blade befitting Wissenland's important status as the centre of Imperial arms production.

wh3_dlc23_spell_bound_the_withering.tooltip: The Wizard destroys the foe from within, corroding their minds with doubt and crisis.

wh3_twa08_spell_bound_the_withering.tooltip: The Wizard destroys the foe from within, corroding their minds with doubt and crisis.

wh2_dlc15_character_abilities_they_needs.tooltip: Get yer stabbers out, boys. We ain’t leavin’ ‘til they's fulla gashes!

wh3_dlc24_hero_abilities_thorns_aura.tooltip: Once caught in a vice-like grip of vines, each thorn is a sharpened blade, piercing the skin and tearing at fragile flesh.

wh3_dlc25_unit_abilities_thunderburner.tooltip: With a sudden rush of piping hot steam, the Thunderbarge soars forward at speed, taking the battlefield by storm.

wh3_dlc25_hero_abilities_titan_headsman.tooltip: When an enemy stands broken and bruised, finishing them off is but a matter of one solid strike.

wh3_main_weapon_abilities_torment_blade.tooltip: This sword is coated with a paralysing venom, a dose of which renders the victim utterly immobile.

wh_main_item_abilities_tricksters_shard.tooltip: A shard of pure aqua, its surface ripples with a malevolent curse bestowed upon it by the Trickster. Any magic-users nearby will surely suffer.

wh2_main_lord_abilities_trophy_heads.tooltip: Oft-times, killers retain the heads of their victims as prizes or reminders of dark deeds done.

wh3_main_daemon_wings_abilities_trophy_h.tooltip: The score must be kept just as surely as the harvested skulls be delivered to the Lord of Murder, atop His mighty Skull Throne.

wh2_dlc16_item_abilities_twilight_horn_i.tooltip: No purer sound is there than a single note from this great horn, capable of emboldening the faint of heart and rousing the timid.

wh_main_character_abilities_undeath_resu.tooltip: Arise! Do not falter! Do not crumble! Back to life once more!

wh2_main_mount_abilities_unholy_clamour.tooltip: As the clanging of the Bell rises alarmingly, the Skaven's squeaking escalates in unison; they know for whom it tolls.

wh2_dlc12_lord_abilities_unlimited_power.tooltip: Unlimited power corrupts the already-totally-corrupted utterly.

wh3_main_pro_character_abilities_ursuns_.tooltip: The blood-curdling howl of Father Bear rallies the men of Kislev to his banner, for their fortunes are forever entwined, and the fate of the Motherland hangs in the balance.

wh3_main_character_abilities_ursuns_roar.tooltip: The blood-curdling howl of Father Bear rallies the men of Kislev to his banner, for their fortunes are forever entwined, and the fate of the Motherland hangs in the balance.

wh_main_item_abilities_van_horstmanns_sp.tooltip: Van Horstmann's small magical mirror has the ability to destroy the enemy if only they will look upon its cracked surface...

wh3_dlc29_lord_abilities_verminous_fury.tooltip: Fervour and madness seep into the very ground the Warbringer walks on.

wh3_main_lord_abilities_virulent_contagi.tooltip: Sulphurous, acerbic disease is no respecter of rank, nobility or prowess in battle; all shall fall afore Nurgle's filthy infections.
ui_effects_text: Will spread to enemies within the Spread Range metres of affected unit

wh3_dlc27_qb_unit_abilities_visions_of_m.tooltip: Desperate bloodlust is a mark of borderline derangement – yet some creatures care not for the limits of mind.

wh3_main_item_abilities_void_pendulum.tooltip: When the pendulum swings, the foe's spellcasters find themselves powerless and magically impotent.

wh3_dlc24_hero_abilities_vorozhejas_fore.tooltip: No enemy can fight the cursed lashings of fate, binding them to their inevitable doom.

wh_main_character_abilities_waaagh.tooltip: The Warboss lifts his head and unleashes a mighty "WAAAGH!" – the boyz echo this terrifying roar as the entire Greenskin horde surges towards the enemy!

wh_main_item_abilities_wand_of_jet.tooltip: The bearer of this black wand, flecked in glowing jade, can increase the Winds and more quickly power his spells.

wh2_dlc15_character_abilities_wardens_ca.tooltip: The Warden summons a magical cage that temporarily traps his target with no chance of escape.
ui_effects_text: If wounded while ability is active, target character will be imprisoned after battle

wh_pro04_unit_abilities_warp_gaze.tooltip: Never make direct eye-contact with a Beastman lest it mark you out for a hideous, flesh-ripping demise.

wh3_dlc24_character_abilities_watched_by.tooltip: Near… far… In fact, wherever it is that you are, Saytang's belittling gaze will find you.

wh3_dlc26_character_abilities_were_you_g.tooltip: If anyone even thinks of fleeing a battle in the Bruiser's presence, they find themselves flung head over heels in the thick of it.

wh2_twa03_weapon_abilities_whip_of_agony.tooltip: Pain nourishes courage in the hearts of the wild and fear in the hearts of the weak.

wh2_main_spell_bound_whip_of_agony.tooltip: As the caster utters a forbidden name, her enemies are wracked with waves of misery.

wh2_dlc14_lord_abilities_whiplash.tooltip: The startling crack of the Beastmaster’s hefty and ever-so-slightly serrated whip of Dragon-sinew suitably infuriates the beasts for battle.

wh3_dlc29_hero_abilities_whispering_mist.tooltip: Cold mists curl about the enemy like a maiden's distracting caress.

wh3_dlc26_lord_abilities_wild_abandon.tooltip: The Bloodspeaker asks the impossible of his followers, and they do it. Many die afterwards. But before that, they kill.

wh3_main_lord_abilities_willing_prey.tooltip: Some beings, in their darkest heart, have a deep-seated desire for an agonising death.

wh3_main_daemon_body_abilities_winds_of_.tooltip: Take me to the magic moment, upon glory night, where the children of tomorrow dream…

wh3_main_daemon_head_abilities_word_of_c.tooltip: Through His ever-willing vessel, the Dark Sorcerer of the Chaos Gods can cause broiling waves of maddening Change to engulf spellcasting foes.

wh2_dlc10_spell_bound_word_of_pain.tooltip: As the caster utters a forbidden name, their enemies are wracked with waves of agony.

wh3_dlc27_spell_dark_magic_word_of_pain_.tooltip: As the caster utters a forbidden name, their enemies are wracked with waves of agony.

wh_dlc05_unit_abilities_woven_mist.tooltip: The Wardancer threads and loops, contorting to create an ethereal fabric that turns aside arrows and bolts.

wh3_main_lord_abilities_wrath_of_the_sto.tooltip: Elements thought uncontrollable can be harnessed to do the Dragon's bidding – both to crush their enemies and protect them when in human form.

wh3_main_lord_abilities_wrathful_reaper.tooltip: Skarbrand runs rampant, twin axes hacking and cleaving until there is no one left to kill.
